Who is Steven Erickson?

Atom Eve Elias Brandyworth † (accidental victim)

Create an perfect super hero under government control Replicate Atom Eve and her powers. (all failed)

Steven Erickson is the leader of a government agency and the main antagonist of the Atom Eve Special.

Steven Erickson appears as a middle aged African-American male. He has black hair and possesses a pencil mustache.
